name: Anthro Northwest
blurb: A PG-rated anthropomorphic arts convention combining furry fandom, costume design, cosplay and performance, held each January in Seattle.

editions.evidence: Official anw9 microsite homepage: 'Anthro Northwest 9 "Beauty" January 7–10, 2027 Hyatt Regency Seattle'; About page: 'ANW 9 January 7, 2027 to January 10, 2027'.

notes: The root domain's homepage (anthronw.com) is a near-empty placeholder with no working nav links; the live convention content is at /anw9/ (found via web search). Corrected the seed note's venue/city: the official site confirms Hyatt Regency Seattle, in Seattle, WA, not SeaTac. No Guests-of-Honor page or 2027 announcement was found (the About page shows staff/mascot fursona art, not guest bios); WikiFur records a guest-of-honor tradition for past years, so guests is none-yet rather than none.
